<!--
  One-page leave-behind. Edit the text inside #ph("...").
  Column groups are Typst grids. From this directory: quarto render
-->

```{=typst}
#let ink = rgb("#1C2421")
#let muted = rgb("#5E675F")
#let accent = rgb("#8C4A22")
#let band = rgb("#F3EFE8")
#let ph(s) = s

#set page(numbering: none, footer: none)
#set text(font: "Lato", fill: ink)
#set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em, spacing: 0.65em)
#set block(spacing: 0.65em)
#set list(marker: text(fill: accent)[•], spacing: 0.38em, indent: 0.9em)

#show heading.where(level: 1): it => {
  block(above: 0.45em, below: 0.45em)[
    #set par(spacing: 0pt)
    #set block(spacing: 0pt)
    #text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#it.body]
    #v(0.28em)
    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.9pt + accent)
  ]
}
#show heading.where(level: 2): it => {
  block(above: 0.15em, below: 0.12em)[
    #text(size: 12.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#it.body]
  ]
}

#align(center)[
  #text(size: 9pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent, tracking: 0.12em)[SMALL-BUSINESS CONSULTING]
  #v(0.4em)
  #text(size: 26pt, weight: "bold")[#ph("Active Analytics")]
  #v(0.35em)
  #text(size: 13pt)[#ph("Helping aspiring small business operators achieve their goals")]
  // #v(0.38em)
  // #text(size: 9pt, fill: muted)[#ph("City")  ·  #ph("email@domain.com")  ·  #ph("phone")  ·  #ph("website")]
]
#v(0.1em)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.5pt + accent)
#v(0.55em)
```
